title: Stuffy Nose, Editing, and My First Chinese Book
titleZh: 鼻塞、剪片与第一本中文书
description: Recording with a stuffy nose after a full day of editing, Steven launches his travel videos with "Do You Really Need a Passport?", shares how each platform is performing, and talks about splitting his channel and making his workflow simpler. He also looks at what his footage gets wrong, like too little B-roll, too many shots of his own face and weak storytelling, and celebrates finishing his first Chinese book for adults after four years.

sentences.zh: 内容速览
sentences.en: Content overview

sentences.zh: 这期节目，史蒂文是带着鼻塞、拿着一瓶新买的鼻喷剂录的，因为他刚剪了一整天视频。
sentences.en: Steven recorded this episode with a stuffy nose and a newly bought bottle of nasal spray, because he had just spent a whole day editing videos.

sentences.zh: 旅行视频终于要陆续发布了，第一支是《护照真的有必要吗？
sentences.en: The travel videos are finally going to be released one after another; the first one is "Is a Passport Really Necessary?

sentences.zh: 他对自己的素材很不客气：真人出镜太多，空镜头太少，还缺一条清晰的故事线。
sentences.en: He's very hard on his own footage: too much of himself on camera, too few B-roll shots, and no clear storyline.

sentences.zh: 节目最后有个好消息：四年来，他终于读完了第一本中文成人读物。
sentences.en: There's good news at the end of the episode: after four years, he has finally finished reading his first Chinese book for adults.

sentences.zh: 鼻喷剂风波，以及为什么节目只有音频
sentences.en: The nasal spray saga, and why the show is audio-only

sentences.zh: 史蒂文和女朋友走路去药店，买了一瓶鼻喷雾。
sentences.en: Steven and his girlfriend walked to the pharmacy and bought a bottle of nasal spray.

sentences.zh: 他的呼吸问题又犯了，原因可能是过敏、花粉，或者“家里某个我不知道的角落长了霉”。
sentences.en: His breathing problems had flared up again, possibly because of allergies, pollen, or "mold growing in some corner of the house I don't know about."

sentences.zh: 他的理论是：整天坐在桌前剪片子，症状会更重。
sentences.en: His theory: sitting at his desk editing videos all day makes the symptoms worse.

sentences.zh: 后来他承认，鼻喷剂“好像没什么用”。
sentences.en: Later he admitted the nasal spray "doesn't really seem to do anything."

sentences.zh: 这也是播客只做音频的原因之一：他通常在傍晚录音，光线很差。
sentences.en: That's also one of the reasons the podcast is audio-only: he usually records in the early evening, when the lighting is bad.

sentences.zh: 他也喜欢纯音频的味道：“你听到的，就是真真切切录下来的。”
sentences.en: He also likes the feel of pure audio: "What you hear is exactly what was really recorded."

sentences.zh: 节目每周更新五天。
sentences.en: The show comes out five days a week.

sentences.zh: 开始发布，平台成绩单
sentences.en: Starting to publish: a platform report card

sentences.zh: 上个月真是忙得团团转。
sentences.en: Last month was really hectic.

sentences.zh: 八月底他拿到了中国工作签证，随后在美国旅行一周，九月中旬飞回中国，开始了新学期。
sentences.en: At the end of August he got his Chinese work visa, then traveled in the US for a week, flew back to China in mid-September, and started the new semester.

sentences.zh: 飞机上，邻座乘客问他是不是YouTuber，他说：“这个称呼可太抬举我了。”
sentences.en: On the plane, the passenger next to him asked if he was a YouTuber, and he said, "That's way too flattering a title for me."

sentences.zh: 《护照真的有必要吗？
sentences.en: "Is a Passport Really Necessary?

sentences.zh: 》现已上线。
sentences.en: " is now live.

sentences.zh: 各平台表现如下：
sentences.en: Here's how it did on each platform:

sentences.zh: Snapchat： 之前的版本有约3000次观看，但他只有七个粉丝。
sentences.en: Snapchat: The earlier version got about 3,000 views, but he has only seven followers.

sentences.zh: 他在这里发视频，主要是因为数据可能会被拿去训练大语言模型。
sentences.en: He posts videos here mainly because the data might be used to train large language models.

sentences.zh: TikTok： 效果忽高忽低。
sentences.en: TikTok: Results are hit-or-miss.

sentences.zh: 有人留言“这也太蠢了”，史蒂文回复：“再看一遍。”
sentences.en: Someone commented "This is so dumb," and Steven replied, "Watch it again."

sentences.zh: Instagram和小红书： 新加坡的视频在Instagram上反响不错，在小红书上带来几个新粉丝，但“谈不上改变人生”。
sentences.en: Instagram and Xiaohongshu: The Singapore video was well received on Instagram and brought a few new followers on Xiaohongshu, but it was "hardly life-changing."

sentences.zh: YouTube： “唯一能给我带来收入的平台。”
sentences.en: YouTube: "The only platform that brings me any income."

sentences.zh: 把频道一分为二
sentences.en: Splitting the channel in two

sentences.zh: 史蒂文的语言博客最初记录的是他学习普通话和俄语的历程，如今已“偏离得相当远”。
sentences.en: Steven's Language Blog first documented his journey learning Mandarin and Russian, but by now it has "drifted pretty far."

sentences.zh: 他倾向于分成两个阵地：一个是冒险旅行vlog，另一个是教育频道，推广英语和雅思课程，也许放在Substack上直接卖课。
sentences.en: He's leaning toward splitting into two fronts: one an adventure travel vlog, the other an educational channel promoting English and IELTS courses, possibly selling courses directly on Substack.

sentences.zh: 两群观众几乎不重合：雅思学生不会去争论护照，而评论区里聊的全是出入境印章和上膛的枪支。
sentences.en: The two audiences barely overlap: IELTS students don't argue about passports, while the comment section is all about entry and exit stamps and loaded guns.

sentences.zh: “天哪，你们这些人。”
sentences.en: "Good grief, you people."

sentences.zh: 据他估算，长视频每一千次观看大约赚一美元，Shorts只有十美分。
sentences.en: By his estimate, long videos earn about one dollar per thousand views, while Shorts earn only ten cents.

sentences.zh: 所以请大家“多看三四遍，多批评我”。
sentences.en: So he asks everyone to "watch it three or four more times, and criticize me more."

sentences.zh: Final Cut Pro字幕与中文字幕
sentences.en: Final Cut Pro subtitles and Chinese subtitles

sentences.zh: 他不再雇剪辑师了。
sentences.en: He no longer hires video editors.

sentences.zh: 他说Final Cut Pro改进后的字幕功能“是个游戏规则改变者”。
sentences.en: He says Final Cut Pro's improved subtitle feature is "a game changer."

sentences.zh: 去年他花了大约600美元买了DaVinci Resolve Studio，随机附赠的Speed Editor至今还躺在盒子里。
sentences.en: Last year he spent about $600 on DaVinci Resolve Studio, and the Speed Editor that came bundled with it is still sitting in its box.

sentences.zh: 他的工作流程是：
sentences.en: His workflow is:

sentences.zh: 在Final Cut Pro里修改英文字幕。
sentences.en: Edit the English subtitles in Final Cut Pro.

sentences.zh: 导出ITT文件，让ChatGPT翻译出中文版。
sentences.en: Export an ITT file and have ChatGPT translate a Chinese version.

sentences.zh: 基本不校对。
sentences.en: He basically doesn't proofread it.

sentences.zh: 女朋友说“够用了”。
sentences.en: His girlfriend says it's "good enough."

sentences.zh: 小红书的帖子他坚持自己用中文写，当作练习。
sentences.en: He insists on writing his Xiaohongshu posts in Chinese himself, as practice.

sentences.zh: 更大的主题是化繁为简：工具少一点，AI自动化少一点，也不去买那些号称能轻松产出内容的昂贵课程。
sentences.en: The bigger theme is simplifying: fewer tools, less AI automation, and not buying those expensive courses that claim to let you churn out content easily.

sentences.zh: “按下那个按钮之前，要做大量的准备和维护。”
sentences.en: "Before you press that button, there's a lot of preparation and maintenance to do."

sentences.zh: 讲故事、空镜头与跳切
sentences.en: Storytelling, B-roll and jump cuts

sentences.zh: 一趟旅行并不等于一个故事：“史蒂夫，你有没有发现，你根本不会讲故事？”
sentences.en: A trip isn't the same as a story: "Steve, have you noticed that you can't tell a story at all?"

sentences.zh: 看着自己在多伦多递交护照的素材，他发现了两个问题：
sentences.en: Watching his footage of handing in his passport in Toronto, he noticed two problems:

sentences.zh: 1. 镜头里全是他的脸。
sentences.en: 1. Every shot was just his face.

sentences.zh: 中国朋友夸他“很帅”已经12年了，可连他自己都看腻了。
sentences.en: His Chinese friends have been calling him "handsome" for 12 years, but even he is tired of looking at it.

sentences.zh: 2. 没有空镜头。
sentences.en: 2. There was no B-roll.

sentences.zh: 前后两个瞬间之间没有衔接，他只好删掉一些片段。
sentences.en: There was nothing connecting one moment to the next, so he had to cut some clips.

sentences.zh: 他上过电影学院，学过用画面讲故事。
sentences.en: He went to film school and learned to tell stories with images.

sentences.zh: 现在他可以让ChatGPT帮忙列一份分镜清单，比如交通工具、路上的行人、路牌，还有拉上背包拉链的特写。
sentences.en: Now he can have ChatGPT help him make a shot list: vehicles, people on the street, road signs, and a close-up of zipping up his backpack.

sentences.zh: 边走边重拍也麻烦，在尼亚加拉大瀑布附近拍到第四遍时，风景和声音都变了，跳切就是这么来的。
sentences.en: Reshooting as you go is a hassle too: by the fourth take near Niagara Falls, the scenery and the sound had changed, and that's where jump cuts come from.

sentences.zh: 不过“明白了这一点，我就知道该怎么改进”。
sentences.en: But "once I understood that, I knew how to improve."

sentences.zh: 评论区与接下来的计划
sentences.en: The comments section and what's next

sentences.zh: 护照视频发布三小时后，就有约1800次观看和10条评论。
sentences.en: Three hours after the passport video went up, it already had about 1,800 views and 10 comments.

sentences.zh: 其中一条写道：“他不懂什么是公民身份。”
sentences.en: One of them said: "He doesn't understand what citizenship is."

sentences.zh: 史蒂文预计争论会越来越热烈。
sentences.en: Steven expects the debate to get more and more heated.

sentences.zh: 接下来的安排：
sentences.en: What's coming up:

sentences.zh: 周三（北京时间）： 签证递交视频。
sentences.en: Wednesday (Beijing time): the visa submission video.

sentences.zh: 周四/周五： 更多Shorts。
sentences.en: Thursday/Friday: more Shorts.

sentences.zh: 冰球名人堂： 一支22到24分钟的博物馆视频。
sentences.en: Hockey Hall of Fame: a 22- to 24-minute museum video.

sentences.zh: 还要不要拍照？
sentences.en: Should he keep taking photos?

sentences.zh: 借助ChatGPT，他做了一个快捷键，能把挑中的照片复制到“待发布”文件夹。
sentences.en: With ChatGPT's help, he made a keyboard shortcut that copies the photos he picks into a "to publish" folder.

sentences.zh: 每个场景他都拍四五张，可大部分照片都在硬盘里吃灰。
sentences.en: He takes four or five shots of every scene, but most of the photos just sit on his hard drive gathering dust.

sentences.zh: 他原本打算用15到18年记录一个工作旅行者的日常，如今“行不通了……是时候改变了”。
sentences.en: He had originally planned to spend 15 to 18 years documenting the daily life of a working traveler, but now "it's not working... it's time for a change."

sentences.zh: 他可能会大幅减少拍照。
sentences.en: He may cut back on taking photos significantly.

sentences.zh: 第一本中文成人读物
sentences.en: The first Chinese book for adults

sentences.zh: 史蒂文读完了一本中文书，只是不确定书名。
sentences.en: Steven finished reading a Chinese book, but he's not sure what it's called.

sentences.zh: 这是一本对话体的访谈，主角是一位开咖啡馆的创业者，出自淘宝上卖的一套廉价创始人访谈丛书。
sentences.en: It's a book of interviews in dialogue form. The main subject is an entrepreneur who opened a café, and it comes from a cheap series of founder interviews sold on Taobao.

sentences.zh: 四年前，他以前的剪辑师把书送给了他。
sentences.en: Four years ago, his former video editor gave him the book.

sentences.zh: 过去一年，它是他的睡前读物，而它“确实很会哄我入睡”。
sentences.en: Over the past year it's been his bedtime reading, and it "really does a good job of putting me to sleep."

sentences.zh: 除了一本漫画，这是他第一本完整读完的中文成人读物。
sentences.en: Apart from a comic book, it's the first Chinese book for adults he's read all the way through.

sentences.zh: “成功！”
sentences.en: "Success!"

sentences.zh: 下一本是图文版的小米创始人雷军传记。
sentences.en: Next up is an illustrated biography of Lei Jun, the founder of Xiaomi.

sentences.zh: 今日总结
sentences.en: Today's summary

sentences.zh: 边生活边做内容，免不了取舍。
sentences.en: Making content while living your life inevitably involves trade-offs.

sentences.zh: 眼下史蒂文的办法是：化繁为简，提前规划镜头，把故事讲好。
sentences.en: For now, Steven's approach is to simplify, plan shots in advance, and tell the story well.

sentences.zh: 只要坚持不懈，终有回报，哪怕一本书要读四年。
sentences.en: As long as you persevere, it will pay off in the end, even if one book takes four years to read.

vocab.en: run around busy, in a whirl
to flatter, to give undue credit
